course.title: Surveying
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: To find the elevation of the top (A) of the minar of KUET mosque, observations were made from two stations P and R, 50 m apart. The horizontal angel measured at P between R and the top of the minar was 60º 45' and that measured at R between the. top of the minar and P station was 72º 30'. The angel of elevation of the top of the minar was measured to be 20º 17' at R and that was 20º 48' at P. Stadia readings on. B.M. When the instrument was at P = 2.969 m and that with the instrument at R = 3.073 m. Calculate the elevation of the minar of KUET mosque if that B.M. was 420m.

topics: Reconnaissance survey; Linear measurements; Traverse survey; Plane table survey; Levelling & contouring; Calculation of areas and volumes; Tachometry: Introduction, principles and problems on tachometry; Astronomical surveying: Definition, instruments, astronomical corrections, systems of time; Introduction of terrestrial photography, aerial photography, reading of photo mosaic, scale Project surveying; Errors in surveying; remote sensing; Introduction and application of global positioning system (GPS) and geographical information system (GIS), House setting.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে মিনিয়ারের উচ্চতা নির্ণয় করার জন্য স্টেডিয়া পদ্ধতি (Stadia readings), কোর্সের ১ নম্বর টপিক 'Tachometry'-এর সরাসরি অধীনে পড়ে।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে স্টেডিয়া পদ্ধতি ব্যবহার করে উচ্চতা নির্ণয় করা হয়েছে যা ট্যাকোমেট্রি (Tachometry) এর সরাসরি অধীনে আসে।
